# Compile run idempotence intended for PR runs

The schema includes indexes (ix_compile_runs_repo_pr and ix_compile_runs_repo_merged) and a comment stating idempotence: a succeeded run per (repo, pr) implies a re-trigger is a no-op.

Support idempotent handling of compile runs for pull requests to avoid re-processing already-succeeded runs.
